app.title: Job Radar
app.tagline: Daily IT job postings: hot skills and salaries

common.notEnough: Not enough salary data (fewer than {min} postings).
common.title: Title

overview.topSkillsHint: Share of jobs that mention at least one known skill
overview.trendHint: By posting date. A site that gives no date uses the day we first saw the job.
overview.dedupe: Postings listed on several sites are counted once.
overview.roleShareHint: Jobs with a known skill, grouped by job title
overview.skillTrendHint: Postings per period that mention each of the five most requested skills
overview.roleSalaryHint: Annualized. The bar spans the 25th to 75th percentile and the tick is the median. Monthly salaries are multiplied by 12; currencies are never converted.

skill.salaryHint: Median and quartiles of the midpoint of each posted range. Monthly salaries are multiplied by 12. Currencies are never converted.
skill.coverage: {n} of {total} postings have a usable salary ({pct}%)

salary.title: Salary by skill
salary.intro: Annualized salary per role and per skill, by currency. Only groups with at least {min} salary postings are shown. Monthly salaries are multiplied by 12 and currencies are never converted.
salary.coverage: Overall: {n} of {total} active postings have a usable salary ({pct}%).
salary.rangeHint: Annualized. The bar spans the 25th to 75th percentile and the tick is the median.

footer.note: Postings belong to their original sites. Follow the links to read and apply there.
